Half day fishing charters are prefect when searching for Striped Bass & Bluefish, we offer two trips daily. If you are looking for some big game fishing Captain McDowell can take you for tuna, marlin and sharks on a full day offshore fishing trip. services.desc: The port of Menemsha is located on the western end of Martha's Vineyard Island off the coast of Cape Cod in the resort town of Chilmark. Menemsha is situated near some of the best rips and rock piles on the east coast, hiding places for trophy striped bass and bluefish. Ten minutes from the harbor is the famous "Devil's Bridge" known as one of the top spots for large striped bass. Not much further is the area around Cuttyhunk Island which contains "Sow and Pigs" reef, a legendary fishing hole. Also within a half-day range is Squibnocket, No Man's Island and Quicks Hole, all considered as some of the best fishing areas in the world for striped bass and bluefish.
